Container.Name: Fider
Container.Overview: Collect and discuss product feedback with Fider. Requires an external PostgreSQL database and a working email provider. Configure the public BASE_URL before starting.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP host port. Container port remains 3000.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Full public URL including https:// when using a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL URL
Config.Description: Replace USERNAME, PASSWORD, HOST and DATABASE with your PostgreSQL details. Use a reachable host, not localhost. Percent-encode special characters in credentials.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Generate a long random secret, for example with openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: Email provider
Config.Description: smtp, mailgun or awsses. See README for alternate provider variables.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Required for SMTP. Not required for Mailgun or SES.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Required for SMTP. Usually 587 with STARTTLS or 465 with implicit TLS.

Config.Name: SMTP username
Config.Description: Optional if the SMTP server does not require authentication.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Optional if the SMTP server does not require authentication.

Config.Name: SMTP STARTTLS
Config.Description: Use true for port 587; use false for implicit TLS on port 465.

Config.Name: SMTP implicit TLS
Config.Description: Set true for port 465 and disable STARTTLS.

Config.Name: File storage
Config.Description: sql, fs or s3. Additional settings required for fs or s3; see README.

Config.Name: Disable site creation
Config.Description: Set true after initial setup. Existing site users can still sign in.

Config.Name: Automatic HTTPS
Config.Description: Keep false behind a reverse proxy. Direct automatic HTTPS requires ports 80 and 443; see README.
